svg.title: Solar Earth: green, icons, roles, type and states
svg.desc: Documentation reference, not implemented UI. Current source uses sage for preference, family participation, plans, shopping and cooking progress, selection and celebration. Existing Lucide icons and text glyphs carry meaning with labels. Proposed pairings preserve broad sage fields and ochre actions; they are not a rebrand or runtime changes. Source evidence is distinct from reported runtime risks and proposed treatments. Includes side-by-side low-contrast specimens and proposed repairs, plus explicit Outfit and Inter role annotations.
svg.text: 01 Current vocabulary → role-specific contrast → review examples
Source: 4682643 · 25 Oct 2026. Schematics, not screenshots or usage counts.
CURRENT SOURCE · sage is more than success
A match is not a saved week
Existing base sage #8A9A5B stays visible, including substantial celebration fields.
Cards summarize source roles; their compact layout and text are explanatory.
Source shapes + labels; legend colours are schematic. Discover uses ochre.
Also present: ♥ / ✕ / ✓ text glyphs; grocery aisle emoji + section names.
UtensilsCrossed also means eating out. Sparkles can mean mystery or delight.
No symbol alone proves saved, cooked or ordered. Keep the contextual label.
CONTRAST REPAIR · keep the hue, show the difference
White / base sage: 3.06:1 for qualifying large text, not small labels.
Flat-pair samples, not control-size targets. Test glass/glow/opacity composites.

g.text: PROPOSED PAIRS · preserve hue, clarify the role
Options reuse existing tokens. Not a universal primary colour or token remap.
All proposed text pairs ≥ 4.5:1. Meaningful edges/icons need their own ≥ 3:1 check.
Sage / cream = 2.97:1: deepen the necessary icon/edge, not every green surface.
PROPOSED TYPE ROLES · keep Outfit + Inter
CSS px starting points, not WCAG minimum font sizes. Local fonts may fall back.
Prefer sentence case; never hide essential state in tiny, faint capitals.
Not saved. Your choice is still here.
Retry save → retry only the failed stage, not already completed work.
24 px glyph ≠ 48 × 48 CSS px hit area.
Proposed generous target; keep labels and spacing.
Name icon-only controls by the action, not the drawing. Hide redundant icons
from assistive technology; expose checked / pressed / current state separately.
These boards do not verify live focus, screen readers or touch behavior.
Keep warm surfaces, distinctive green and earned delight; repair the hard-to-read role.
Reference only. Sources, contrast thresholds, licensing and scope are in the guide.
